title: Run it · louis-agent
text: Run it Run it where you want. Everything here runs in Docker, on your own machine or a server of your own. The framework's two websites run in Azure, from the same images you can start at home. Start on your machine, watch it on the dashboard, then ship it. Run it On your own machine. Two stacks run the agent and the sites. Every port binds to your own machine only, and each stack reads its settings from its own config folder. Type the commands from the repo's root. demos/louis-agent/docker/docker-compose.yml The coding agent's API with its code-review app on port 5082, Rider's ACP and MCP servers, and the agent in a terminal. A local model through Ollama joins under the ollama , ollama-nvidia or ollama-amd profile. src/site/docker/docker-compose.yml louis-agent.dev on port 5080 and this site on 5084, from the same images that run in Azure. Start them Ask Copy docker compose -f demos/louis-agent/docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file demos/louis-agent/config/.env up -d --build api docker compose -f src/site/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build The coding stack Every setting Run it Watch every turn. Start the dashboard once, beside the others. Every turn, model request and tool call shows up there as a trace, with its logs. demos/louis-agent/docker/docker-compose.observability.yml The Aspire dashboard. Its page is on port 18888, and the stacks send it their logs and traces over OTLP on 4317. It keeps everything in memory, so a restart forgets it. Start the dashboard Ask Copy docker compose -f demos/louis-agent/docker/docker-compose.observability.yml up -d Debug and logs Run it Shipped on every merge. louis-agent.dev and this site run in Azure. You merge a pull request, and both sites go out. deploy-sites.yml Every merge to main releases both sites from GitHub, so nobody's machine needs to be on. deploy.ps1 The one script that does every job. The workflow runs it, and you can run the same verbs from your own PC. Container Apps Each site is one Azure Container App that sleeps when nobody visits. The first visitor after a quiet spell waits a few seconds for it to wake. Deploy the sites The sites in Azure
